ownerModel.notes: Historical extra Codex WBS labels are absorbed by Codex #1 under the current two-instance flow.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Issue, PR, branch, review comment, and CI evidence work for WBS execution.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: GitHub issue comments, PR timeline, branch history, and Actions logs.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Required for Codex #1 to ship scoped PRs and prove CI green under WBS due-date order.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Read and summarize Notion specs or implementation plans when explicitly referenced.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Notion page history plus issue/PR links that cite the readback.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Supports spec-to-implementation intake without adding extra live agent instances.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Read Slack context and draft updates for WBS coordination when the user asks.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Slack message permalink plus issue/PR note before any outbound send.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Coordination data may inform WBS routing, but outbound writes stay human-approved.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Read referenced Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides artifacts for issue evidence.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Drive file URL, readback summary, and issue/PR link.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Needed for referenced source intake while preserving manual approval for file writes.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Read availability and daily context when calendar evidence is explicitly requested.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Calendar action summary and issue/PR link before any change.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Calendar context may guide WBS scheduling, while event mutations remain approval-gated.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Read referenced email threads and draft replies only when the user asks.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Email thread reference plus explicit user approval before send/delete.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Useful for user-requested inbox triage without autonomous outbound email.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Harness-engineering source intake and long-context research summaries.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Notebook id, source URL/path, generated summary, and issue/PR link.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Issue #1586 depends on NotebookLM recheck evidence, but source changes stay recorded.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Read-only public documentation lookup for implementation details.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Issue/PR note with the package or documentation source consulted.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Public-doc lookup is allowed when scoped; any write-capable variant is denied by default.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Browser screenshots, console inspection, and visual evidence for UI checks.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Playwright artifacts, screenshots, and PR validation summary.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: UI verification needs deterministic browser evidence without adding extra live instances.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Read-only local memory lookup for handoff and historical context.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Issue/PR note that identifies which memory source informed the change.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Memory lookup reduces duplicate WBS investigation while writes remain outside Codex #1 scope.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Read existing scheduled task state when reconciling automation issues.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Automation id, issue link, and explicit user approval for mutations.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Read-only schedule inspection helps avoid duplicate automations.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: In-app browser navigation for local or public UI inspection.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Browser target URL and screenshot/console evidence in the PR summary.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Codex #1 can gather UI evidence without launching another development instance.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Local document rendering and verification for explicit file tasks.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Changed local file path and render verification summary.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Local runtime is allowed for user-requested document artifacts only.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Local spreadsheet inspection, formatting, and verification for explicit file tasks.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Changed local file path and verification summary.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Local runtime is allowed for user-requested spreadsheet artifacts only.

allowedMcpServers.purpose: Local slide deck rendering and verification for explicit file tasks.
allowedMcpServers.auditLog: Changed local file path and render verification summary.
allowedMcpServers.allowedReason: Local runtime is allowed for user-requested presentation artifacts only.

deniedMcpServers.deniedReason: Default-deny boundary: no external MCP server may be added without this file recording purpose, scopes, data classification, approver, and audit log.
Production data access must go through reviewed Supabase scripts, GitHub Actions, or explicit user-approved runbooks.
Context7 is approved for public documentation lookup only; write/admin variants are out of scope.
Not part of the two-instance WBS execution lane; re-enable only with a task-specific packet and approval.
Broad plugin surface is not required for scoped WBS PRs and must remain blocked unless explicitly approved.
